A89_KHI_context.applies_to: C4T-KHI only, not an NGC A/B timing estimate
A89_KHI_context.r6_rule: No V007 seal delay. r5 seals unless all r6 build/bitwise/review/identity gates arrive in time. Later step4/5 r6 use needs its own gates and root ruling.

current_A_stage_model_hours: T_A = (15.07 to 25.07 inherited illustrative hours)*(actual_iterations/16) + delta_T120L_K32_cut_tail (unknown signed correction)
current_B_incremental_model_hours: T_B = sum(actual reference/body/offset/free-surface/rotation/feedback/column-mean stage hours); no matching completed route-B measurement; unknown until root first point.
first_point_rule: Root reserves machine resources, sets nonbinding initial monitor limits, measures actual per-stage wall/RSS/disk and updates a new immutable schedule. Never use these projections as failure/admission thresholds.
inherited_assumptions: serial prep; linear W scaling; ideal column parallelism; design tail estimate; no failed-column search cost
integrated_headline_per_point_hours: T_A + T_B; finite upper bound UNTESTED/unavailable.
optional_stage0_per_point_hours: T_A(stage0)+T_B(stage0), independently measured; do not assume A2 timing equivalence.
qualification: Old saved G80C partial-column observations and K15 design estimates; not a measurement of K32, not a valid K32 lower/upper bound, and not a cut selection. Current point/cut/tail costs unknown.
total_for_n_points: sum_i(T_Ai+T_Bi) + separately registered ORIGINAL_K and sensitivity work; optional stage0 after headline only with spare compute.
